bugs.defect: Unused subscriptions were buried and their fake cancel action claimed Opened.
bugs.fix: Unused records now precede renewals; each action opens an explicit local cancellation preview, preserving the existing flags without claiming provider access.

bugs.defect: Bank selection looked like connection success despite no authentication.
bugs.fix: Preview-bank CTA and the returning money-screen notice explicitly describe sample balances and no connected bank; selection, flag and route survive.

bugs.defect: Every ledger detail claimed grocery categorisation and weekly grocery behaviour.
bugs.fix: Selected payment infers its initial category; grocery-specific facts stay with the Tesco sample, while other ledger records retain their own direction and type. Category editing and local splitting remain.

bugs.defect: Historical balance dates were detached from the seed date and invalid saved indices could produce undefined figures.
bugs.fix: Scrubber dates derive from seed.date and the existing history length; indices are finite, rounded and bounded.

bugs.defect: Completed missions appeared in active lists and submitted sample work was mixed with urgent next actions.
bugs.fix: Active filtering excludes cleared IDs; needs-you missions are urgency-ordered and waiting sample HMRC work has its own section. Local history remains reversible.

bugs.defect: Any tax-category mission inherited the P800 refund, reference and draft.
bugs.fix: P800-specific presentation now applies only to uk-hmrc-tax-code; other missions retain their own core estimates, steps, explanation and drafts.

bugs.defect: Level-labelled decision cards bypassed the existing unlock flow; toolkit counts described thirteen records while only eight were shown.
bugs.fix: Decision navigation uses the existing unlock choices and open-early path; directory counts derive from its actual eight-tool list, with a useful empty-search state.

bugs.defect: Every document borrowed passport-only GOV.UK renewal facts, and renewal-preview/removal actions had no useful visible result.
bugs.fix: Passport keeps GOV.UK timing and fee caveats; other documents use their issuer/reference. Renewal preview is visibly local, copy removal is per-document and undoable, and encryption/reminders are not claimed live.

bugs.defect: Supplement timing claimed No clashes without an interaction check.
bugs.fix: Removed the unsupported status, retained doses, iron GP flag and pharmacist caveat, and explicitly identified the example as not an interaction check.

bugs.defect: Results, inputs and next actions were separated by repetitive cards or squeezed horizontal content.
bugs.fix: Cash input sits beside its result; income conclusion precedes the two-option comparison; housing shortfall precedes projection; mission steps are vertical; ledger/budget/history read as open records; insurance urgency leads the archive and renewal screen. Long title/status pairs wrap using existing tokens.

bugs.defect: A blank intention could be explicitly filed, and the home council-tax link could reopen a different selected mission.
bugs.fix: Blank Add is disabled and guarded; the home and Money-area council/HMRC links select their intended existing mission IDs. No proposal auto-filing was added.

limits: Only the four assigned screen files and this JSON were edited. No branch, worktree, commit, push, services, libraries, browser or server.

Owned TSX files have zero TypeScript parser diagnostics and git diff --check is clean. No typecheck, test suite, exports, integration run or screenshot was performed; the coordinator owns final integration and visual verification.

Existing finance/housing engines, seeded numbers, clinical marker order/interpretation, draft edit/copy/mail, checklists, preferences and navigation remain. Shared Screen/TopBar/rows/cards/tokens are coordinator-owned.
393pt/1.3 Dynamic Type is addressed structurally with wrapping pairs, fitting text variants, open vertical steps and flexible account/compare layouts; exact light/dark rendering remains unverified.

Document, banking, cancellation, reminder and case-provider integrations remain local/demo. Sample case timelines and the new-goal starting plan remain seeded, not externally verified or newly generated. Existing health/work generic mission links were retained rather than inventing catalogue mappings.
